none: PAS FindID 974787: Silver denarius Roman Republic
contea di ritrovamento: Stockton-on-Tees (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete silver denarius of the Roman Republican period (BC85). Obverse description: Laureate head of Apollo Vejovis right. Thunderbolt below. Obverse inscription: M.FONTEI, monograph or CF below chin. Reverse description: Infant winged Genius riding goat right, caps of Dioscuri above, filleted thyrsos below, all within laurel wreath. The coin is in a poor condition with a great deal of wear on both faces. It is unclear if there is a monogram below the chin or 'CF', as appears on some. Diameter: 18.51mm. Thickness: 1.41mm. Weight: 3.2g. Crawford 353/1a, Sydenham 724 or Crawford 353/1c, Sydenham 724a
